import unittest

class Behavior(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_contract(self):
        from badges import holder
        data = {'Mira':'B-41', 'Noah':'B-08', 'B-41':'B-90', 'Lin':''}
        self.assertEqual(holder(data, 'B-41'), 'Mira')
        self.assertEqual(holder(data, 'B-90'), 'B-41')
        self.assertEqual(holder(data, 'B-08'), 'Noah')
        self.assertEqual(holder(data, ''), 'Lin')
        self.assertIsNone(holder(data, 'b-41'))
        self.assertIsNone(holder(data, 'Noah'))
        self.assertIsNone(holder({}, 'B-41'))
        self.assertEqual(data, {'Mira':'B-41', 'Noah':'B-08', 'B-41':'B-90', 'Lin':''})

if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
